title: Docs after a review fix
context: When review asks for a fix after the docs were already updated, what should happen to the docs before the final checks? Docs are now updated while review runs, so a review fix can leave the docs describing the code as it was before the fix. Running the docs step again costs back some of the 3 to 8 minutes this change saves. Five experts raised this; the flow, the tests and the done-when depend on the answer.
